KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

inputs.name: model
inputs.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.tooltip: The latent image to denoise.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.

inputs.name: text
inputs.tooltip: The text to be encoded.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

EmptyLatentImage.description: Create a new batch of empty latent images to be denoised via sampling.

inputs.name: width
inputs.tooltip: The width of the latent images in pixels.

inputs.name: height
inputs.tooltip: The height of the latent images in pixels.

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

SaveImage.description: Saves the input images to your ComfyUI output directory.

inputs.name: images
inputs.tooltip: The images to save.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

VAEDecode.description: Decodes latent images back into pixel space images.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.tooltip: The latent to be decoded.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.tooltip: The VAE model used for decoding the latent.

raw.text:
{
  "nodes": {
    "KSampler": {
      "classType": "KSampler",
      "displayName": "KSampler",
      "description": "Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.",
      "category": "model/sampling",
      "outputNode": false,
      "deprecated": false,
      "experimental": false,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "name": "model",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "MODEL",
          "required": true,
          "tooltip": "The model used for denoising the input latent."
        },
        {
          "name": "seed",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "INT",
          "required": true,
          "default": 0,
          "min": 0,
          "max": 18446744073709552000,
          "tooltip": "The random seed used for creating the noise."
        },
        {
          "name": "steps",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "INT",
          "required": true,
          "default": 20,
          "min": 1,
          "max": 10000,
          "tooltip": "The number of steps used in the denoising process."
        },
        {
          "name": "cfg",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "FLOAT",
          "required": true,
          "default": 8,
          "min": 0,
          "max": 100,
          "step": 0.1,
          "tooltip": "The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality."
        },
        {
          "name": "sampler_name",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "COMBO",
          "required": true,
          "options": [
            "euler",
            "euler_cfg_pp",
            "euler_ancestral",
            "euler_ancestral_cfg_pp",
            "heun",
            "heunpp2",
            "exp_heun_2_x0",
            "exp_heun_2_x0_sde",
            "dpm_2",
            "dpm_2_ancestral",
            "lms",
            "dpm_fast",
            "dpm_adaptive",
            "dpmpp_2s_ancestral",
            "dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp",
            "dpmpp_sde",
            "dpmpp_sde_gpu",
            "dpmpp_2m",
            "dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp",
            "dpmpp_2m_sde",
            "dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu",
            "dpmpp_2m_sde_heun",
            "dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu",
            "dpmpp_3m_sde",
            "dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu",
            "ddpm",
            "lcm",
            "ipndm",
            "ipndm_v",
            "deis",
            "cfgpp_ud10_ab",
            "res_multistep",
            "res_multistep_cfg_pp",
            "res_multistep_ancestral",
            "res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp",
            "gradient_estimation",
            "gradient_estimation_cfg_pp",
            "er_sde",
            "seeds_2",
            "seeds_3",
            "sa_solver",
            "sa_solver_pece",
            "ddim",
            "uni_pc",
            "uni_pc_bh2"
          ],
          "tooltip": "The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output."
        },
        {
          "name": "scheduler",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "COMBO",
          "required": true,
          "options": [
            "simple",
            "sgm_uniform",
            "karras",
            "exponential",
            "ddim_uniform",
            "beta",
            "normal",
            "linear_quadratic",
            "kl_optimal"
          ],
          "tooltip": "The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image."
        },
        {
          "name": "positive",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "CONDITIONING",
          "required": true,
          "tooltip": "The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image."
        },
        {
          "name": "negative",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "CONDITIONING",
          "required": true,
          "tooltip": "The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image."
        },
        {
          "name": "latent_image",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "LATENT",
          "required": true,
          "tooltip": "The latent image to denoise."
        },
        {
          "name": "denoise",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "FLOAT",
          "required": true,
          "default": 1,
          "min": 0,
          "max": 1,
          "step": 0.01,
          "tooltip": "The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling."
        }
      ],
      "inputOrder": [
        "model",
        "seed",
        "steps",
        "cfg",
        "sampler_name",
        "scheduler",
        "positive",
        "negative",
        "latent_image",
        "denoise"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "name": "LATENT",
          "type": "LATENT",
          "list": false
        }
      ]
    },
    "CLIPTextEncode": {
      "classType": "CLIPTextEncode",
      "displayName": "CLIP Text Encode (Prompt)",
      "description": "Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.",
      "category": "model/conditioning",
      "outputNode": false,
      "deprecated": false,
      "experimental": false,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "STRING",
          "required": true,
          "tooltip": "The text to be encoded."
        },
        {
          "name": "clip",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "CLIP",
          "required": true,
          "tooltip": "The CLIP model used for encoding the text."
        }
      ],
      "inputOrder": [
        "text",
        "clip"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "name": "CONDITIONING",
          "type": "CONDITIONING",
          "list": false
        }
      ]
    },
    "CheckpointLoaderSimple": {
      "classType": "CheckpointLoaderSimple",
      "displayName": "Load Checkpoint",
      "description": "Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.",
      "category": "model/loaders",
      "outputNode": false,
      "deprecated": false,
      "experimental": false,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "name": "ckpt_name",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "COMBO",
          "required": true,
          "options": [
            "ltx-2-19b-dev-fp8.safetensors",
            "ltx-2-19b-dev.safetensors",
            "ltx-2-19b-distilled.safetensors",
            "ltx-2.3-22b-dev-fp8.safetensors",
            "ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-fp8.safetensors"
          ],
          "tooltip": "The name of the checkpoint (model) to load."
        }
      ],
      "inputOrder": [
        "ckpt_name"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "name": "MODEL",
          "type": "MODEL",
          "list": false
        },
        {
          "name": "CLIP",
          "type": "CLIP",
          "list": false
        },
        {
          "name": "VAE",
          "type": "VAE",
          "list": false
        }
      ]
    },
    "EmptyLatentImage": {
      "classType": "EmptyLatentImage",
      "displayName": "Empty Latent Image",
      "description": "Create a new batch of empty latent images to be denoised via sampling.",
      "category": "model/latent",
      "outputNode": false,
      "deprecated": false,
      "experimental": false,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "name": "width",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "INT",
          "required": true,
          "default": 1024,
          "min": 16,
          "max": 16384,
          "step": 8,
          "tooltip": "The width of the latent images in pixels."
        },
        {
          "name": "height",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "INT",
          "required": true,
          "default": 1024,
          "min": 16,
          "max": 16384,
          "step": 8,
          "tooltip": "The height of the latent images in pixels."
        },
        {
          "name": "batch_size",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "INT",
          "required": true,
          "default": 1,
          "min": 1,
          "max": 4096,
          "tooltip": "The number of latent images in the batch."
        }
      ],
      "inputOrder": [
        "width",
        "height",
        "batch_size"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "name": "LATENT",
          "type": "LATENT",
          "list": false
        }
      ]
    },
    "SaveImage": {
      "classType": "SaveImage",
      "displayName": "Save Image",
      "description": "Saves the input images to your ComfyUI output directory.",
      "category": "image",
      "outputNode": true,
      "deprecated": false,
      "experimental": false,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "name": "images",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "IMAGE",
          "required": true,
          "tooltip": "The images to save."
        },
        {
          "name": "filename_prefix",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "STRING",
          "required": true,
          "default": "ComfyUI",
          "tooltip": "The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes."
        }
      ],
      "inputOrder": [
        "images",
        "filename_prefix"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "name": "images",
          "type": "IMAGE",
          "list": false
        }
      ]
    },
    "VAEDecode": {
      "classType": "VAEDecode",
      "displayName": "VAE Decode",
      "description": "Decodes latent images back into pixel space images.",
      "category": "model/latent",
      "outputNode": false,
      "deprecated": false,
      "experimental": false,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "name": "samples",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "LATENT",
          "required": true,
          "tooltip": "The latent to be decoded."
        },
        {
          "name": "vae",
          "group": "required",
          "type": "VAE",
          "required": true,
          "tooltip": "The VAE model used for decoding the latent."
        }
      ],
      "inputOrder": [
        "samples",
        "vae"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "name": "IMAGE",
          "type": "IMAGE",
          "list": false
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "missing": []
}
